name: editor.gesture
title: editor.gesture
summary: Begin or end an active human field gesture; agent ops on this exact field wait at most two seconds.
html:
Begin or end an active human field gesture; agent ops on this exact field wait at most two seconds.

  • Scope: edit:scene
  • Service: gesture

#Params

ParamRequiredDescription
sessionyesHuman editor session owning this gesture.
docyesDocument path or ID.
entityyesEntity ID or prefab address.
pathyesExact reflected field path, such as Transform.position.x.
activeyesBegin/continue the gesture, or end/cancel it.
